$comment: Starter tool library. Milwaukee's product pages publish a tool's overall Length and its bare weight, but NOT width or height, so no entry here has a complete bounding box from a published source. 'l' values with source 'milwaukee-spec' are the published Length (converted from inches at 25.4). 'w' and 'h' are null until measured -- a top-down pocket needs all three. Measure with the battery you actually store on the tool (or none), on a flat surface. Set verified:true only after you have measured all three yourself.

tools.name: M18 FUEL 1/2" Hammer Drill/Driver (bare)
tools.source: milwaukee-spec: milwaukeetool.com product 2904-20, Length 6.95 in. w/h need measurement.
tools.notes: Length is nose-to-back-of-housing. Height (chuck to base of battery) and width (grip) must be measured. Batteried footprint is larger.

tools.name: M18 FUEL 1/4" Hex Impact Driver (bare)
tools.source: Length 4.47 in from milwaukeetool.com (2953-20). Side-profile outline traced from the Sketchfab model 'Milwaukee M18 Impact 1/4" Hex' by nicknothom (sketchfab.com/3d-models/2ef3aa17e2da486dabeea824c13b84d9), scaled so nose-to-tail = 113.5 mm.
tools.notes: PROVISIONAL / not caliper-verified. Modelled lying on its SIDE: bbox l = length (nose-to-tail), w = tool height (head top to grip base, no battery, ~124 mm), h = body width (~66 mm, becomes pocket depth). pocketRects (tool-local mm, x along length / y = height) approximate: [nose collar, hammer head, motor body, grip, grip foot]. Confirm head/grip positions and body width with calipers before printing.

tools.name: M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 Battery
tools.notes: Milwaukee does not publish battery pack dimensions. Measure. Batteries pack tightly -- a smaller clearance is usually fine.
